summary: RptMnuNextAssignmentReport is an ASP.NET user control for generating a 'Next Assignment Report'. It enables users to select agencies, set date ranges, and export the report in Excel/CSV format. The control interfaces with a backend database and renders HTML/CSV output for reporting.
purpose: To allow authorized users to generate, view, and export the Next Assignment Report based on specified agencies and date ranges.

workflows.name: Generate and Export Next Assignment Report
steps: User loads the report menu user control.
User selects receiving agencies via UCchoosersRcvAgency.
User sets start and end dates using txtStartDate and txtEndDate; both fields validated with RequiredFieldValidator and RegularExpressionValidator.
On cmdExcel_Click, parameters (SessionID, CutoverDate, NextCutoverDate, RcvAgencyList) are added to DB procedure ReportGoneTo.
Data is retrieved via UserSession.DB.GetData() and SqlDataReader.
Report output is rendered in HTML/CSV using ReportMain.OutputCSV.
HTML content is assigned to lblReportHTML and pnlReportHTML is set visible if reportHTML is not empty.
User can export the report using the Excel button (cmdRunExcel).
Page and ScriptManager setup JavaScript variables for fields on load/pre-render for client-side scripting.

business_rules: Only agencies included in IncludedList are used in the report.
Start and end date fields are required and format-validated.
User session must be active for report generation.
Descriptions and options for the report are pulled from CodeRecord via Codes.CodeLookupCodes.
validations: RequiredFieldValidator on txtStartDate and txtEndDate (valEditStartDate, valEditEndDate).
RegularExpressionValidator on txtStartDate and txtEndDate (RegularExpressionValidator1, RegularExpressionValidator2).
CustomValidator1 and CustomValidator2 for potentially custom business logic.
calculations: DateFormatter.ParseDate used to parse user-inputted date fields.
ReportMain.OutputCSV processes SqlDataReader and generates report output.
conditions: If UserSession is null, no processing occurs.
If reportHTML is empty, pnlReportHTML is not shown.
ScriptMgr.IsInAsyncPostBack determines how JavaScript is registered.
system_behavior: PreRender populates description and options literals from lookup codes.
JavaScript variables setup for use in page scripts.
Report output rendered and displayed dynamically.
exceptions: Empty reportHTML returns no visible report panel.
Invalid or missing required fields trigger validation errors.
UserSession null or expired disables report functionality.
content_gaps: No detailed business logic for custom validators.
No information regarding specific data fields in the output CSV.
No sample output or field mapping from SqlDataReader to report structure.
No explicit explanations for error handling or edge case management.
